overview: Leonida is a static recompilation project that aims to run the Xbox Series version of Grand Theft Auto VI natively on Windows by translating GPU shaders to Vulkan and reimplementing console system software. A learner can study how console-to-PC recompilation works, including shader translation from RDNA2 to SPIR-V, asset extraction from game archives, and low-level graphics pipeline construction.
how_to_start: Obtain your own copy of Grand Theft Auto VI for Xbox Series (version 1.0.2.1) with files readable on disk.
Check the README section "How to build" (linked as #how-to-build) for build instructions.
Review the project status table to understand what components work (shader translation, model/texture export) and what does not (booting, playable game).
Join the Discord (https://discord.gg/rexed) for developer discussion and support.
